# TC Decks

> TC Decks (Tippetts Construction) is a family-owned deck builder based in Saratoga Springs, Utah, founded by Levi Tippetts in 2005. It designs and builds custom composite decks, covered decks, pergolas, porches and railings, and full deck tear-out and rebuilds, across Utah County and Salt Lake County.

Key facts:

- Owner: Levi Tippetts, a third-generation Utah builder
- Founded: 2005
- Based in: Saratoga Springs, Utah (service-area business)
- Service area: Utah County and Salt Lake County, including Saratoga Springs, Lehi, Eagle Mountain, American Fork, Pleasant Grove, Lindon, Highland, Alpine, Cedar Hills, Vineyard, Orem, Provo, Sundance, Spanish Fork, Springville, Mapleton, Payson, Santaquin, Draper, Sandy, South Jordan, West Jordan, Herriman, Riverton and Bluffdale
- License: Utah contractor license #5899795-5501, licensed and insured
- Certifications: TimberTech Platinum Pro; certified Pro Installer for Trex, Deckorators and Fortress; member of the Owens Corning OC Lumber Pro Build Team; member of NADRA and the NAHB
- Warranty: 7-year workmanship warranty, plus manufacturer labor and material coverage as a certified installer
- Rating: 4.9 stars on Google
- Estimates: free, over the phone; every booked project gets a 3D rendering
- Financing: through Wisetack, loans up to $65,000
- Scope: new decks and full tear-out and rebuilds only; no small deck repairs
- Phone: 801-472-8939
- Email: tippettsconstruction@gmail.com
- Hours: Monday to Saturday, 7am to 8pm
- Recognition: a TC Decks Pleasant Grove deck was on the cover of Deck Specialist magazine (Fall 2021)

## Services

- [Custom decks](https://www.tcdecksutah.com/custom-deck-design-construction): design and build of new decks
- [Composite decks](https://www.tcdecksutah.com/composite-decks): TimberTech, Trex and Deckorators composite and PVC decking
- [Deck tear-out and rebuild](https://www.tcdecksutah.com/deck-replacement): full replacement from the footings up
- [Pergolas and covered patios](https://www.tcdecksutah.com/pergolas)
- [Porches and railings](https://www.tcdecksutah.com/porches-railings)
- [Certified Pro Installer](https://www.tcdecksutah.com/certified-pro-installer): manufacturer certifications and warranty coverage
- [OC Lumber](https://www.tcdecksutah.com/oc-lumber): rot-proof Glas-Powered Lumber framing
- [Financing](https://www.tcdecksutah.com/financing)
